title: Salt's Last Grain
logline: A salt harvester and curator confront the last natural salt, choosing to preserve it together.

world.premise: In a near-future where synthetic salt dominates, two guardians tend the last wild salt source on the coast.
world.palette: saturated sky blues and warm ochres, high-contrast key art

visual_grammar.render: 2D cel animation, visible line art, flat colour fills
visual_grammar.lens: wide compositions, limited animation, held frames with slow pans
visual_grammar.lighting: painted light, hard cel shadows in two tones, bloom on practicals
visual_grammar.negative: text, watermark, extra fingers, warped architecture, style change, photorealism, 3D render, live-action faces, motion blur

C1.name: Maren
C1.locked_appearance: Maren, mid-30s, stocky build, sun-weathered face, matted salt-crusted brown hair, oilskin overalls, wooden salt scoop.

C2.name: Kael
C2.locked_appearance: Kael, late 20s, lean build, sharp jaw, short black hair, linen tunic, ceramic salt jar.

L1.name: Coastal Salt Marshes
L1.locked_description: Tidal mudflats, weathered wooden salt pans, rusted metal tide gates, a single weathered wooden hut.

L2.name: Coastal Storage Shed
L2.locked_description: Cinder block walls, concrete floor, metal shelving units, wall-mounted wooden jar rack.

continuity_rules.text: Maren’s wooden salt scoop has a cracked handle
Kael’s ceramic salt jar has a chipped rim
L1’s salt pans are always covered in a thin white salt crust
L2’s metal shelving has a rust spot on the middle shelf

episodes.title: The Last Grain
episodes.logline: Two guardians of wild salt decide to preserve the final batch together.

beats.action: Maren kneels in a salt pan, scooping salt into her wooden scoop
beats.camera: medium shot, slow pan across mudflats
beats.line: This is the last wild salt.

beats.action: Kael approaches, holding his chipped ceramic salt jar
beats.camera: wide shot, slow push-in to their meeting

beats.action: They pour salt into Kael’s jar in the storage shed
beats.camera: close-up, slow zoom on merging salt grains
